trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 single-player trophies; no multiplayer trophy is required for this platinum. Use the checklist to find anything outstanding, then this award unlocks automatically when the full set registers.

roadmap.note: Platinum unlock after the other 54 trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, the first main mission in Chapter 1, and let the mission sequence finish. This story trophy is automatic and cannot be missed, so continue through the objectives until the game records the completion.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 to receive this automatic story award. It unlocks as you advance into Chapter 2; keep following the main-story prompts and avoid cheats, which disable saving and trophies.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 and continue into Chapter 3 for this automatic milestone. It is tied to campaign progression rather than an optional objective, and is not missable.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's main story to unlock this chapter award. The trophy follows the campaign transition into Chapter 4, so there is no extra medal or collectible condition.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4's final main mission to receive the chapter trophy. Let the mission and its completion sequence finish before switching activities; it is a standard automatic story unlock.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the campaign's final mission and allow the ending sequence to resolve. There is no mission replay, so keep a rotating manual save if you want chapter checkpoints; free roam remains open afterward.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Follow its mission objectives through the finish; this is an automatic story trophy and requires no medal or optional condition.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist during Chapter 3. Stay with the main mission until its result resolves and the completion is recorded; no additional challenge condition is listed.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play in Chapter 4 to unlock the automatic award. Complete the mission objectives and wait for the ending transition before leaving the activity.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in the Chapter 4 campaign. The story trophy is automatic, so follow the main mission through its final objective and let its result register.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. The award follows its completion; continue to the mission's end instead of interrupting the sequence.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory during Chapter 5. This is a story-linked unlock with no separate medal requirement; allow the mission to complete and save.

roadmap.note: Earn naturally while completing the named story mission or chapter.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the finale, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and use that list to track the remaining requirements. Story progress already counts; the checklist calls for partial completion in many categories, including studying 100 of 255 animals and scanning 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, rather than doing every world activity. Nothing required for this trophy is missable, according to the roadmap.

roadmap.note: After the finale, finish the in-game 100% checklist; story progress carries over.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts; you can mix stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights, and base jumps. Track totals under Progress > Activities > Stunts and choose whichever category is easiest in each region; a stunt counts when completed once, with no extra challenge condition.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Complete one activity from each of the nine types, then confirm the categories under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. The list includes fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt; story and exploration introduce most of them naturally.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the 12 ranges. Use the range challenge list to see what still lacks gold, then repeat those trials; this is a stricter requirement than the 100% checklist.

sources.title: PowerPyx — Shooting Range Gold Medal Challenges

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; the guide lists 42 races total. Follow the location guide or map markers and finish each race in first place, tracking sites already cleared.

sources.title: PowerPyx — Top Fun Drone Race Locations

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeating the same event does not satisfy the distinct-race requirement. Use the race locations guide to find a varied set, and check the trophy progress counter as you win.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After Feng Shui in Chapter 1, Cal can text you a purple fishing marker. Follow his fishing questline to its challenge and beat his score; the trophy is for winning the challenge, not simply fishing once.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete all levels in any one of the four video games. The first three are playable at a home TV, while Bang For Your Buck is at arcade machines; finish a game's full level sequence, without needing to beat its extra challenges.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's five-part optional questline as Lucia. Her call and text mark the Belville strand during Chapter 3; complete Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. The strand remains available after the story.

roadmap.note: Complete the stranger strand or hunting task; return after story if temporarily unavailable.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's treasure-diving strand: recover and return the requested underwater treasures through all seven shipwrecks. He is introduced after Island Dreams and may temporarily disappear after Chapter 1; check Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and return later in Chapters 2–3 or free roam.

sources.title: PowerPyx — Island Dreams: Work for Kenton

roadmap.note: Complete the stranger strand or hunting task; return after story if temporarily unavailable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five optional missions, beginning after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. His marker is at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, and the strand remains available after the campaign.

roadmap.note: Complete the stranger strand or hunting task; return after story if temporarily unavailable.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying stranger strands, not just eight individual side missions. Many character strands do not count; check the trophy's tracker in the PlayStation trophy list and use the side-mission guide to identify eligible chains. These open-world strands remain available after the story.

roadmap.note: Complete the stranger strand or hunting task; return after story if temporarily unavailable.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's Wish List, which begins after Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs in Chapter 3. Deliver the 16 requested sports cars to Randy in west Vice City; scan high-end vehicles with WAiNK to check requests, and use Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List to track them. This remains available after the story.

roadmap.note: Complete the stranger strand or hunting task; return after story if temporarily unavailable.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: As Jason, complete Tyrone's strand after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3. Destroy enough marked Synthetic Labs during Take Out Kitty Litter to unlock Spin On This, then finish that final mission; the chain remains available after the story.

roadmap.note: Complete the stranger strand or hunting task; return after story if temporarily unavailable.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations and check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Safeguard the potentially missable Chapter 1 session: after Down to Earth, speak with Lucia in the kitchen when she mentions meditating, follow her to Jason's balcony, and accept. The guide says it is not yet confirmed whether that one-time session is required, so do it while available; later spots can be tracked in the collection menu.

roadmap.note: Safeguard Lucia’s one-time Chapter 1 meditation after Down to Earth.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, watch for Bret Vogel's text while playing as Jason; it marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Complete the introduction, then hunt the requested target animals at his purple markers and return them to Bret. The guide notes the exact animal for this trophy is still being confirmed.

roadmap.note: Complete the stranger strand or hunting task; return after story if temporarily unavailable.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three full Collectible Card sets; the guide lists 18 sets. Track missing cards by set and use the location guide for the final gaps; individual cards alone do not complete a set.

roadmap.note: Sweep the remaining card sets or WAiNK scan counter in free roam.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK to scan 100 environmental locations; the guide lists more than 100 available objects. Landmark, curiosity, sculpture, and tag scans can contribute, so keep scanning newly found objects and check the collection counter rather than scanning the same spot again.

roadmap.note: Sweep the remaining card sets or WAiNK scan counter in free roam.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Track them under Progress > Challenges and choose the easiest remaining objectives; the 100% checklist asks for 70, so this trophy is typically completed during that cleanup.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner and escape a four-star wanted level together. The guide notes large bank robberies later in Chapter 4 naturally trigger four stars; get outside the red heat zone with your partner for the unlock.

roadmap.note: Work on during the campaign when the activity becomes available; clean up later if needed.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, rob three shops back-to-back with your partner while the wanted state remains active throughout. Robbery targets show as green map icons; keep the police pursuit from clearing between stops. The award can be delayed after leaving the third shop.

roadmap.note: Work on during the campaign when the activity becomes available; clean up later if needed.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicle models by scanning new vehicles with WAiNK; driving them is not required. Scan varied traffic, boats, and aircraft and check Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles for the totals; 100% completion requires 200 base models, so this often comes naturally.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: While aiming a firearm, activate Combat Focus and incapacitate or kill five enemies before that single focus burst ends. Build the purple focus meter first, then use a quick full-auto weapon against a group; the guide says police, soldiers, and civilians may not count.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a passenger plane attached to a boarding bridge, reach its cockpit, take off, and fly about 1 km away from the airport. The guide says planes parked on the open airfield do not count; a terminal-connected aircraft is needed for the unscheduled departure.

roadmap.note: Work on during the campaign when the activity becomes available; clean up later if needed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, at the southwest edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks are in the south of the base; once inside, fire on enemies until the trophy registers.

roadmap.note: Work on during the campaign when the activity becomes available; clean up later if needed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies, enter a jewelry store through its locked rear door using the Snap Gun. Avoid the alarm, find the safe code in the back room, and leave undetected; kicking the door triggers detection.

roadmap.note: Work on during the campaign when the activity becomes available; clean up later if needed.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete five of the eight large bank vault robberies. The intro arrives through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…; follow the security van to a bank, enter while its vault is open, then escape the four-star heat. Track which vaults are done from their map markers.

roadmap.note: Work on during the campaign when the activity becomes available; clean up later if needed.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. One route opens with the same Chapter 4 bank-vault mission: follow the truck and rob the bank vault; alternatively, stop a roaming armored truck and breach its rear. Make sure the getaway completes before counting it.

roadmap.note: Work on during the campaign when the activity becomes available; clean up later if needed.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog every region of Leonida, using a plane to sweep map areas still covered in black. Check the map edges and offshore areas too; the progress counter updates as each part is revealed.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the nine gangs; there are 39 operations in total. Their icons appear as you approach or progress the story, and the gang tracker is under Progress > Gangs. Ensure each faction has one completed operation, not merely nine operations overall.

roadmap.note: Work on during the campaign when the activity becomes available; clean up later if needed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The guide currently reports this clue-only trophy's trigger as unknown. Its official hint points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so try the beachfront drink interaction and wait for the scene to complete; avoid treating this as confirmed until the trophy notification appears.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs unlocks the Key Cloner, steal the blue Banshee displayed in the showroom in south Vice City. Hack it and drive straight through the showroom window, then continue down the street; the guide says this specific car is required and the unlock may be delayed.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: During Chapter 2's Hit Kingpin Bowling operation, collect all three key valuables in the bowling alley: the luxury watch, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun, and the office safe contents. Escape the police to trigger the trophy; if one item is missed, the robbery icon can return later and missing valuables still count.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break lets the pair roam together, raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength to maximum at the same time. Work out at a fitness club with your partner called along; while one character trains, the other gains progress too. Check each character's Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.

roadmap.note: Work on during the campaign when the activity becomes available; clean up later if needed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile and watch for the on-screen profile notification. Robberies and combat contribute; enable Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile to see what counts, then check the trophy counter for remaining actions.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The guide reports this clue's trigger as unknown, with a possible Payday Loans connection. Keep it as a cleanup trophy and watch the counter or unlock notification while replaying relevant attempts; no verified specific action is provided by the source.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The guide reports this cryptic trophy as unknown, with a possible UFO-quest connection. Explore strange encounters and follow any unusual questline prompts, but treat that lead as unconfirmed until the trophy unlock notification appears.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The guide reports the trigger as unknown and suggests a possible melee kick from a moving motorcycle. Try the melee-drive-by interaction against an enemy while riding, then verify the result; the source does not confirm the exact trigger.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After Credit Check in Chapter 3 unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, rob banks or Payday Loans and deliver marked bills to a fence. Accumulate $250,000 processed across multiple hand-ins; Yasmani pays well, and bank vault jobs later provide larger bundles.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 at shops; expensive weapon, vehicle-modification, or tattoo purchases add up fastest. Check the trophy counter and remember only shop spending counts toward this sum.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2, buy the eight garages through the Vice City Real Estate phone app. Their combined price is $160,000; story garages do not count toward the purchasable-property requirement, so check that all eight listings are owned.

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: After Moses in Chapter 2 installs Scooter Bros, buy enough garages for vehicle storage and register ten eligible stolen vehicles. Take them to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray > Register; later in Chapter 3, standard-tracker vehicles can also be registered at Pay 'n' Spray locations.

sources.title: PowerPyx — Moses: Take a Vehicle to Moses

roadmap.note: Free-roam activity or miscellaneous cleanup; track the counter in progress menus.
